hints.title: Row and Column Count Separation
hints.text: A black pixel is lonely if and only if its row contains exactly one black pixel and its column contains exactly one black pixel.

hints.title: Two-Pass Histogram Technique
hints.text: First pass computes the number of black pixels in each row and column. Second pass counts pixels matching lonely criteria.

hints.title: Grid Traversal Count Verification
hints.text: Tally black pixels in arrays row_count and col_count. Loop over every cell (r, c); if picture[r][c] is black and both row_count[r] and col_count[c] equal one, increment answer counter.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N) time and O(M + N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning entire row and column for each black pixel takes O(M * N * (M + N)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two linear frequency arrays cache row and column sums, reducing per-cell lonely checks to O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that decoupling row and column tallying enables a clean two-pass algorithm.
